principles.selection_rule: promote only after point-in-time validation, cost modeling, walk-forward testing, calibration checks, multiple-testing control, and demo execution validation
principles.portfolio_rule: combine signals only after risk normalization and correlation-aware exposure control
principles.notes: These are evidence-backed research candidates, not guaranteed profitable strategies or investment recommendations.

strategies.name: Cross-Asset Time-Series Momentum
strategies.signal: sign of each instrument's own trailing excess/total return
strategies.holding: rebalance daily; signal can persist until reversal
strategies.evidence_basis: Documented across equity index, currency, commodity, and government bond futures with one-year signals and shorter-to-medium horizons.

strategies.name: Cross-Sectional Momentum
strategies.signal: rank instruments by trailing risk-adjusted return within comparable asset buckets
strategies.portfolio: long upper quantile, short lower quantile where the instrument/broker permits; otherwise directional ranking sleeve
strategies.sizing: volatility and beta neutralization before aggregation
strategies.evidence_basis: Momentum evidence extends across multiple markets and asset classes; the implementation must avoid look-ahead and excessive turnover.

strategies.name: Multi-Asset Carry
strategies.signal: expected return from holding the asset assuming market conditions are otherwise unchanged

implementations.equity_indices: dividend and financing carry where robust data exists

strategies.evidence_basis: Carry has been documented across equities, bonds, currencies, commodities and related markets, with the important caveat that broad carry can suffer in global stress periods.

strategies.name: Cross-Asset Value / Relative Mispricing
strategies.signal: slow-moving valuation or relative-price deviation from a defined economic anchor

implementations.commodities: inventory/curve/long-run relative valuation where data quality supports it
implementations.equities: fundamental valuation for broad equity universe, separate from index-only sleeve

strategies.sizing: slow turnover, volatility normalized, strong exposure caps
strategies.evidence_basis: Value premia have been documented across several markets and asset classes, but implementation is much more data-sensitive than pure price-based trend.

strategies.name: Defensive / Low-Risk Allocation
strategies.signal: prefer lower-beta or lower-risk exposures within eligible cross sections
strategies.portfolio: beta-controlled or market-neutral where instrument access permits
strategies.sizing: risk parity within sleeve; strict leverage ceiling
strategies.evidence_basis: Low-risk/betting-against-beta effects have been studied in equities and multiple asset classes; the construction is sensitive to leverage, beta estimation and financing assumptions.

strategies.name: Short-Horizon Mean Reversion
strategies.signal: short-term standardized return or price dislocation that reverts after controlling for trend and volatility
strategies.sizing: small risk budget; volatility and spread adjusted
strategies.evidence_basis: Used here as a hypothesis requiring rigorous cost and turnover testing; short-horizon effects are especially vulnerable to implementation friction.

strategies.name: Portfolio Volatility Targeting
strategies.signal: scale aggregate exposure inversely with forecast realized volatility
strategies.sizing: cap-and-floor exposure multiplier; never overrides hard risk limits
strategies.evidence_basis: A portfolio construction control rather than an alpha source; must be evaluated after costs and against pro-cyclical deleveraging risk.

strategies.name: Market-Regime Risk Overlay
strategies.signal: detect abnormal volatility, correlation, liquidity, spread, event and broker states
strategies.action: reduce, block or freeze candidate orders; never create broker orders by itself
strategies.evidence_basis: Risk-control layer; deliberately separated from predictive alpha so it cannot silently manufacture signals.
